scope: Final episode: five complete DE/FR/ES/JA/KO editions, bounded corrections to existing ZH/EN, Traditional Chinese derived from corrected ZH, existing URLs retained. Completes the 26-episode upgrade.
review_boundary: Root read the complete Chinese and English source essays and archive notes. Language reviewers read every assigned target manuscript against the Chinese source and reread their final editions. Root read all changed target-language passages and all 19 English replacements before freeze.
preservation: Immutable original ZH/EN body snapshots and external ZIPs preserved. Exact source replacements retain section and paragraph boundaries. Each target manuscript retains eight sections and 29 paragraphs, with full arguments and examples rather than summaries.
editorial_decisions: Date the First Red Scare after World War I, as already corrected by the incoming five-language package.
Limit the half-workforce coverage claim to initial contributory old-age insurance, not the whole Social Security system.

Distinguish institutional design and opportunities for correction from guaranteed self-correction or uninterrupted historical openness; explicitly retain Civil War and Reconstruction as rupture and rebuilding.

Keep the constitutional distinction between federal employees subject to a strike prohibition and private-sector workers under the Wagner Act, while preserving the essay's political interpretation of PATCO.
Keep administrative reorganization within congressional authorizations and statutory limits; avoid universal claims of postwar contraction.

Clarify that persons-as-ends is not a guaranteed historical destination, without withdrawing the author's normative commitment or rewriting the recursive, two-sided and relational-remainder arguments.
